## Named Storms Per Year

The following visualization displays the number of unique named storms per year in the `dplyr::storms` dataset.

```{r plot-storms}
storms |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(n_storms = n_distinct(name)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
    subtitle = "Data source: dplyr::storms",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Named Storms"
  )
```
